1.title: Healthcare Pricing Is Impossible Without LLMs | TJ Parker
1.author: MTS
1.hook: TJ Parker (General Medicine CEO) on parsing insurance PDFs with LLMs to surface copays, Walmart partnership mechanics, why insurance structures won't change for 5 years, and autonomous agents transacting care directly.

1.title: Cybersecurity Must Be Rewritten Within Years | Alex Stamos
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Alex Stamos (Cognition CSO, ex-Facebook/Yahoo) argues open-weight models create a cybersecurity inflection point where attackers on cheap hardware outpace defenders using expensive frontier models; discusses Cognition's Devin Security approach to automated bug fixing.

1.author: MTS
1.hook: a16z on agent-to-agent negotiation via MCP protocols and how autonomous agents will displace traditional recruiting networks; includes Cosign Awards launch and discussion of talent graph mapping.

1.title: Chucky (MrBeast) on Dynamic Thumbnails, Video A/B, and the YouTube Algorithm
1.author: Creator Insider
1.hook: MrBeast's virality head + YouTube's discovery director on dynamic thumbnails, A/B testing mechanics (titles + intros + traffic source packaging), algorithm ranking beyond CTR, and back-catalog optimization—with concrete examples of when non-face thumbnails outperform and how custom feeds work.
